chunks: And it has been narrated: “Residing in Mecca hardens the heart.”

key_terms.الْقَلْبَ: the heart, meaning the inner spiritual state
key_terms.الْمُقَامَ: residing or staying for an extended period
key_terms.يُقْسِي: makes hard or causes to become hardened

ai.seo_question: What does the hadith mean by saying that residing in Mecca hardens the heart?
ai.summary: This hadith reports a caution regarding prolonged residence in Mecca, stating that it hardens the heart. Its significance is ethical and spiritual, warning that even a sacred place does not automatically guarantee inward softness or spiritual benefit.
